title.value: Perfluoroalkyl and Polyfluoroalkyl Chemicals Consumer Protection Law
title.provenance: Provides that the amendatory Act may be referred to as the Perfluoroalkyl and Polyfluoroalkyl Chemicals Consumer Protection Law.

pfas_definition.provenance: "PFAS chemical" means any of the perfluoroalkyl substances or polyfluoroalkyl substances included in the United States Environmental Protection Agency's expanded ToxCast chemical inventory.

type.provenance: On and after January 1, 2025, no person shall sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in the State any product in any of the following product categories if the product contains an intentionally added PFAS chemical

who.provenance: no person shall sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in the State

action.provenance: no person shall sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in the State

products.provenance: (c) On and after January 1, 2025, no person shall sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in the State any product in any of the following product categories if the product contains an intentionally added PFAS chemical: (1) Carpets or rugs. (2) Fabric treatments. (3) Food packaging. (4) Juvenile products. (5) Oil and gas products. (6) Apparel.

value: Product sold or resold before the effective date of this amendatory Act of the 103rd General Assembly
exceptions.provenance: (4) A product sold or resold before the effective date of this amendatory Act of the 103rd General Assembly.

intentionally_added.provenance: if the product contains an intentionally added PFAS chemical

type.provenance: On and after January 1, 2025, a PFAS manufacturer of cookware sold in this State that contains an intentionally added PFAS chemical in the handle of the cookware or in any surface of the cookware that comes into contact with food, foodstuffs, or beverages shall list the presence of PFAS chemicals on the cookware's product label

who.provenance: a PFAS manufacturer of cookware sold in this State

action.provenance: a PFAS manufacturer of cookware sold in this State that contains an intentionally added PFAS chemical in the handle of the cookware or in any surface of the cookware that comes into contact with food, foodstuffs, or beverages shall list the presence of PFAS chemicals on the cookware's product label

products.provenance: a PFAS manufacturer of cookware sold in this State

value: Cookware that meets the requirements of subsection (h)
exceptions.provenance: (h) Cookware is exempt from this Section if it meets all of the following requirements: (1) The surface area of the cookware is not large enough for a product label that meets the requirements of subsection (f) to be affixed to the item. (2) The cookware does not have any of the following: (A) An exterior container or wrapper upon which a product label can appear or be affixed. (B) A tag or label to which information about the cookware may be attached.

intentionally_added.provenance: contains an intentionally added PFAS chemical
